verdict.rationale: Orb computes revenue analytics natively from its own billing data. It calculates ASC606 recognized revenue automatically, tracks recognized and deferred revenue, and tracks accrued revenue with forecasting and expansion spotting. Backfilled events feed its analytics. However, the evidence never names MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV, and the data-export docs point toward the warehouse/BI approach the story wants to avoid. Missing for 10: explicit MRR reporting, churn metrics, cohort retention analysis, LTV calculation, and independent hands-on corroboration of native SaaS-metrics dashboards.
